text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Shinko 
Windy, we passed through the shopping 
district in the evening...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm? There's a crowd gathering, nanoda. 
What are they doing...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh?! Look, minion! It's a lottery 
raffle!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Mister, mister! Let Windy-chan draw one 
too, dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, full of energy, aren't we? Do you 
have a raffle ticket?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You can't get in without a ticket? 
Grrrr...!
choice_data_list:
Looks like you get one if you buy 
something.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Is that true?! You should've said so 
sooner, nanoda—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then we gotta hurry and buy 
something!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe~~! The good prize is gonna be won 
by Windy-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with the lottery ticket in hand, 
Shinko Windy triumphantly turned the crank 
of the raffle drum!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay! I did ittt! Did I just pull the 
absolute best one!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Which means, that means...! We get to go 
on a hot springs trip?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
We did it! A spacious hot spring, 
delicious food, and fluffy futons all to 
the two of us♪
choice_data_list: All to the two of you?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ? Windy-chan and you...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!! B-B-B-But! It says "Pairs" right 
here! You can't do it alone!
choice_data_list:
Is there anyone else you want to 
invite...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up, nano~! Windy-chan needs someone 
to carry her luggage, nano!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan doesn't just go around 
inviting people! But she does need someone 
to carry her bags!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make you do the prep, the 
guiding, AND the cleanup after we get 
back, all of ittttt! So you'd better brace 
yourself, nanoda~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Shinko Windy thrust the hot 
springs trip ticket upon me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: If you lose it, you get a 'CHOMP!' got it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Take Windy-chan there once her schedule 
clears up a bit! Got it?"
choice_data_list:
Are you really sure you want to go with 
me?
Are you sure I'm the one you want?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A "No", huh...?
choice_data_list: I don't hate it at all—I'm thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fufun~♪ Then it's settled!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up holding onto the travel 
voucher. Once she achieves a big goal, 
I'll take her on a trip to celebrate...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! It looks so yummy! It's so huge~! 
*drool*...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Just watching that made me hungry! Let's 
hurry back and eat!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We bought salads, onigiri, and even 
desserts at the shopping street, and 
decided to eat together back in the 
Trainer's Room.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, smells so good... Where's the 
knife? Hurry, hurry! Let's split it in 
half~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Chomp, gulp... Mmmph! Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"It's the kind Windy-chan loves! A 
'hard-packed hamburger steak'!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Like I saaaid! It was chewy and super 
meaty. Tasted like there barely weren't 
any binders!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The carrots aren't overboiled either, and 
they have just the right amount of 
sweetness... Heheh♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It tasted just like the one Mom makes! 
Though Mom's is definitely way tastier!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While learning about Shinko Windy's food 
preferences, we enjoyed a pleasant dinner 
together...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so many carrots...! Second prize is 
pretty good too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, eat as much as you like...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No! It would be such a waste to just eat 
this mountain of carrots normally!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ghehehe~~!! I'm totally using this for 
pranks~~~!!!
choice_data_list: Wh-What are you planning to do...!?
Wh-What are you planning to do...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*knock knock*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Comiiing... Huh, nobody's here...? That's 
weird... Wait, what's this...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What!? There's a carrot on the ground! Is 
this a surprise?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Windy! It's you, isn't it?! You've 
been leaving carrots in front of 
everyone's rooms and playing ding-dong 
ditch lately!”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, Windy-chan doesn't know anything 
about that! It wasn't Windy-chan, no way!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, mine was in my shoe locker. It was 
truly earth-shattering.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what do you know! So the President 
noticed it properly after all, huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You didn't say anything, so I thought you 
went in the back and didn't notice me...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Blllllleeeeeeeeh! I don't know anything 
about that~~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, normally I would take proper 
measures to deal with pranks, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, everyone is so pleased~. Thank you 
for sharing your treats, Windy-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmphhh! I'm not Windy-chan, noddaaa~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Geez... So stubborn... Was sharing a piece 
of it really that embarrassing for her...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—And that's the kind of prank I went and 
pulled!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh! The Miho dorm is buzzing with 
talk about the mysterious 'Phantom Carrot 
Dropper'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy wore a smug look. I'm so glad 
it was a prank that made everyone 
happy...! I breathed a silent sigh of 
relief.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A carrot... Just one, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmmmmmm.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll take it, I guess... but after I went 
out of my way to go shopping and all...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Even though I did...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uuu... Ugaaaahhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy suddenly started chomping 
down on a carrot head-first!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Humph! I ate it all in one go!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan is a villain after all! I went 
all wild on them!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is punishment for disappointing 
Windy-chan! Become nourishment for an evil 
Umamusume~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy looks satisfied after having 
a light snack. I hope she eats plenty and 
grows big and strong.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Tissues... it is...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gugigi, this is so boringgg...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to land it more like... with a 
bigger 'BAM!'..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmh! That's it, I'm going home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy began stomping off toward the 
academy, looking visibly irritated.
